title: Document
description: Generated by `cargo run -p tmark-ir --example schema` from the Rust types of tmark-ir; do not edit. A parsed file. Design §Shape.

AbbrDef.description: A `*[HTML]: HyperText Markup Language` definition. Spec §Glossary and acronyms.

counter.description: Counter prefix of a theorem-type admonition.

reference.description: Text of the "See page N" link, with a `{page}` field.

Align.description: Horizontal alignment of a column or cell. Spec §Table (`l|c|r|j`). Mirrors Python `Align = Literal["l", "c", "r", "j"]`; the long forms (`left`, `center`, `centre`, `right`, `justify`, `justified`) are accepted by the parser and normalised here (`ALIGN_ALIASES`).

Attrs.description:
The attribute list of a host element.

Order is normalised by the printer (`#id`, `.class`, keys in source order). The universal attributes `#id`, `lang` and `media` have accessors but stay in the list so unknown hosts round-trip.

id_span.description: Source range of the id token without its `#`, when the list was parsed from text (spec §Round-trip and source spans; design 03 §Identity and spans). `None` when built by a pass or from JSON.

kv.description: `key=value` entries, in source order. Duplicate keys are kept; `get` returns the first.

Author.description: Spec §Front matter: `authors: [{name, affiliation}]`. A bare string item (`authors: [Ada Lovelace]`) is the name alone (C9: TMark tolerates what TeXSmith accepts).

Block.description: Spec §Node catalogue, block entries. Serialised with a `type` tag.

oneOf.description: A paragraph, with an optional `{lead}[…]` run-in. Spec §Para.
Inline content without paragraph semantics (tight list items).
`#` to `######`. Spec §Header. The id lives in `attrs`.
A fenced or indented code block. Spec §CodeBlock, listing. `options` holds the info-string keys (`title`, `linenums`, `hl_lines`, `include`).
PHP-Markdown-Extra definition list. Spec §DefinitionList. Each item is a term and its definitions.
A table of any rung of the ladder. Spec §Table.

source.description: The body of a `yaml table` fence the parser reported a `table-*` diagnostic on: `model` is then a best effort and the printer writes this text back as typed (design 03 §Tables). `None` for a table the model holds faithfully.

oneOf.description: A `yaml table-config` fence, attached to the preceding [`Table`] by a pass; kept as a node so round-trip is exact. Spec §Table rung 3.

columns.description: Positional, matched against the table's leaf columns.

source.description: The fence body when the parser reported a `table-*` diagnostic on it; printed back as typed (see [`Table::source`]).

oneOf.description: `Kind: text {#id}` caption line. Spec §Caption. The anchor lives in `attrs`; `position` is what the printer normalises.
`::: figure`. Spec §Image, Figure: the images inside are subfigures.
`::: warning {title="…"}`, `!!! warning "…"`. Spec §Admonition. `collapsed` is an attribute.

kind.description: The type word: built-in, theorem, or declared.

oneOf.description: `{include}(file)` alone on its line. Spec §Includes. TeXSmith splices.
`<!-- … -->`, inline or block. Spec §Comment. Zero width in the flow.

CaptionPosition.description: Source position of a caption line relative to its float. Spec §Caption: after is canonical, before is accepted sugar.

Cell.description:
One slot of the leaf matrix. Mirrors Python `LeafCell` (`value`, `absorbed`, `rows`, `cols`, `align`; `origin` is implied by the position). A cell written as `{value, rows, cols, align}` in the YAML form is Python's `RichCell`; a bare scalar is a cell with the defaults.

A spanning cell carries `rows`/`cols` greater than 1 and the slots it covers are present too, marked `absorbed` (the `~` of the YAML form under a row span; the slots to the right of a column span are absorbed without being written), so every data row has exactly one cell per leaf column.

absorbed.description: Python `LeafCell.absorbed`: covered by a spanning cell above or to the left.

content.description: Python `LeafCell.value`, parsed as inline Markdown; empty for an empty (`~`) or absorbed cell.

Column.description: Spec §Table rung 5: "Grouped headers (recursive `columns:`)". Mirrors Python `Column = LeafColumn | ColumnGroup`.

oneOf.description: A terminal column. Mirrors Python `LeafColumn`: `name` is `None` when the column has no header label; a table whose columns all lack a name has no header row. A bare scalar column descriptor (`Fruit`, `2024`) is a leaf named by its text.

width.description: Python `_ColumnAttrs.width`: `X`, `NN%` or an opaque backend length (`auto` on a column is also a flexible column).

width_group.description: Python `_ColumnAttrs.width_group` (YAML key `width-group`, the underscore spelling is accepted too): columns sharing a group get the same computed width. Any scalar, coerced to text.

oneOf.description: A header group over an ordered list of sub-columns (recursive). Mirrors Python `ColumnGroup` (`name` required, `columns` non-empty).

width.description: Python `_ColumnAttrs.width`: `X`, `NN%` or an opaque backend length (`auto` on a column is also a flexible column).

width_group.description: Python `_ColumnAttrs.width_group` (YAML key `width-group`, the underscore spelling is accepted too): columns sharing a group get the same computed width. Any scalar, coerced to text.

ColumnConfig.description: The optional layout trio every column-like entry carries. Mirrors Python `_ColumnAttrs` (and `ColumnConfig`, the entries of a `yaml table-config` fence, which adds nothing to it).

width.description: Python `_ColumnAttrs.width`: `X`, `NN%` or an opaque backend length (`auto` on a column is also a flexible column).

width_group.description: Python `_ColumnAttrs.width_group` (YAML key `width-group`, the underscore spelling is accepted too): columns sharing a group get the same computed width. Any scalar, coerced to text.

name.description: Label word, used in references and diagnostics.

ref.description: Template a reference renders, with `{name}` and `{number}` fields.

Declare.description: `declare`: what things *are*. Spec §Front matter, §Counters, §Admonition, §Glossary and acronyms.

acronyms.description: Structure owned by TeXSmith for now; kept as JSON.

glossary.description: Structure owned by TeXSmith for now; kept as JSON.

Epigraph.description: Spec §BlockQuote: `epigraph: {quote, source}` placed before the first heading.

FrontMatter.description: The front matter of a document. `raw` is the YAML text between the fences, copied byte for byte by the printer (ADR 0004).

deprecated.description: Deprecated top-level spellings met while parsing (`bibliography`, `counters`, …), for the caller to report as `deprecated-frontmatter-key`.

extra.description: Root keys TMark does not own, plus `press` keys it does not own under `extra.press`. An object, empty when there is nothing.

Inline.description: Spec §Node catalogue, inline entries. Serialised with a `type` tag.

oneOf.description: A run of text. Spec §Inline text.
A newline inside a paragraph, kept so prose is not re-wrapped (design §Node catalogue).
`$…$`. Spec §Math (inline). Display math is [`MathBlock`]; `display` is kept for `\[…\]` inside a paragraph.
`@key`, `@[key, locator; key2]`. Spec §Ref, §Cite. Resolution decides label versus citation versus glossary.
A footnote: `[^label]` refers to a [`Footnote`] definition, `^[text]` is inline and carries its `content`. Exactly one of the two is set. Spec §Note.

key_span.description: Source range of `key` alone (design 03 §Identity and spans).

oneOf.description: `{aside}[…]`, `::: aside`. Spec §Aside (the IR name of the spec's `MarginNote`).
`[x]{attrs}`: the anonymous span, a host for `#id`, `lang`, `media`. Spec §Roles. Named `SpanNode` in Rust because [`Span`] is the source range; its JSON `type` is `"Span"`.
A substituted acronym, resolved from `Document::abbreviations`. Spec §Glossary and acronyms.
`<!-- … -->`, inline or block. Spec §Comment. Zero width in the flow.

Keys.description: The typed subset of the front matter (spec §Front matter). Serialises to the canonical layout: metadata at the root, the rest under `press`.

date.description: ISO date, free text, or `commit`; kept as written.

title.description: `None` when absent (the first heading is promoted), `Some(None)` for `title: null` (spec §Header: opt out of promotion).

ListStyle.description: Numbering style of an ordered list (`pymdownx.fancylists` markers, spec Appendix "PyMdownX compatibility profile").

Press.description: The `press` namespace, restricted to the keys TMark reads.

base_level.description: What a top-level `#` maps to (`chapter`, `section`, …). Spec §Header.

features.description: Spec §Feature registry: dotted name to switch.

RefItem.description: One item of a reference or citation group. Spec §Ref, §Cite (Pandoc's item grammar).

key.description: The key as written, prefix included (`fig:boot`, `ein05`, `Fig:x`).

key_span.description: Source range of `key` alone: no `@`, `-`, prefix or suffix (spec §Round-trip and source spans; design 03 §Identity and spans). `Span::default()` when the item was built from JSON.

oneOf.description: A row of data: one cell per leaf column, in column order. Mirrors Python `DataRow` (`label`, `cells`, `source`) after `build_matrix`: the label is the first leaf cell (the first top-level column is the label column), the top-level cells are expanded into leaves.

named.description: Python `DataRow.source == "named"`: written in named-row mode (`- Label: {Column: value}` or `- {label: …, cells: {…}}`) rather than positionally; the printer re-emits the same mode.

oneOf.description: A horizontal rule between rows, optionally labelled. Mirrors Python `Separator` (written `separator: true` with `label`/`double-rule` next to it, or `separator: {label, double-rule}`).

Scope.description: Numbering scope of a counter. Spec §Counters (`scope`).

Side.description: Layout hint of an aside. Spec §Aside.

bibliography.description: A map of key to DOI URL or pybtex-shaped entry, or a list of `.bib` paths; kept as JSON, `tmark-registry` interprets it.

SubSpan.description: Byte span of a token inside its node, as [file, start, end]

TableModel.description: Spec §Table: the model every rung of the ladder lowers to. Mirrors Python `Table` (`settings`, `columns`, `rows`, `footer`). Pipe tables produce one with no spans and no groups.

columns.description: Python `Table.columns` (at least two in a `yaml table`).

TableSettings.description: Knobs of the `table:` section of a `yaml table` or `yaml table-config` payload. Spec §Table rung 5 (`long` and `placement`). Mirrors Python `TableSettings` (`extra="forbid"`: an unknown key is `table-unknown-key`).

long.description: Python `TableSettings.long: bool | Literal["auto"]`: `Some(true)` forces a multi-page table, `Some(false)` forbids it, `None` is `auto` (the default; written `long: auto` reads back as `None`).

placement.description: Python `TableSettings.placement`: float placement letters (`htbp`), backend-specific; `_PLACEMENT_RE` is the lint `table-placement`.

width.description: Python `TableSettings.width` (`"auto"` by default): `auto`, `X`, `NN%` or an opaque backend length. `x` is normalised to `X` (`_validate_width`); the percentage range is `table-width`.

Target.description: Where a link points. Spec §Ref (textual references) and §Includes.
